segments.name: pop toy business
segments.description: Incubates IP and sells pop toys and related products to consumers in the PRC through the pop toy business.
segments.evidence: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, as a result of the acquisition of Shenzhen Letsvan in March 2025, we identified one more operating segment, pop toy business.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay for pop toys; revenue comes solely from pop toy sales and related activities.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues from continuing operations, generated solely from pop toy sales and related activities, were RMB596.8 million (US$88.0 million) for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, from RMB65.8 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025.

changes.text: In March 2025 the company acquired Shenzhen Letsvan, which added the pop toy business as an operating segment.
changes.evidence: For the year ended June 30, 2025, as a result of the acquisition of Shenzhen Letsvan in March 2025 (Note 3), the Group identified one more operating segment, pop toy business.

changes.text: The legacy businesses were disposed of in September 2025, leaving pop toy as the only reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Subsequent to the disposal of Divested Business in September 2025 (Note 4), the Group's CODM relies upon the consolidated results of operations as a whole for the only remaining pop toy business when making decisions about allocating resources and assessing the performance of the Group.
